note.question: How can a manufacturer coordinate an independent retailer's capacity-constrained physical-store assortment when the manufacturer also operates an online channel?
note.overview: The manufacturer leads with wholesale terms and the independent retailer chooses a capacity-constrained store assortment; scope contracts are designed to implement the centralized assortment in this sequential channel game.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: In the decentralized benchmark, the manufacturer announces product-level wholesale prices and the retailer then selects a capacity-constrained store assortment; consumers subsequently choose products and channels and may return purchases. For coordination, the manufacturer instead commits to a scope contract with attribute-level wholesale discounts and, when needed, a lump-sum transfer, after which the retailer chooses the assortment. manufacturer-retailer Stackelberg game capacity-constrained assortment subgame
